description: Header file defining the interface for the N-Band equaliser (LVEQNB) module, including types, structures, function prototypes, and constants used for configuring and processing the equaliser.

methods.name: LVEQNB_Memory
methods.description: Allocates or frees memory for the equaliser instance, returning memory requirements or allocated addresses.

methods.name: LVEQNB_Init
methods.description: Creates and initializes an instance of the N-Band equaliser module.

methods.name: LVEQNB_GetParameters
methods.description: Retrieves current parameters of the equaliser instance.

methods.name: LVEQNB_GetCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the capabilities of the equaliser instance.

methods.name: LVEQNB_Control
methods.description: Sets or updates parameters of the equaliser instance.

methods.name: LVEQNB_Process
methods.description: Processes input audio data through the equaliser.
